newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 850 MW Conemaugh 2 coal unit shuts briefly.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 850 MW Conemaugh 2 coal unit shuts briefly.

text.p: A 850 megawatt (MW) unit at the Conemaugh coal-fired generating complex was expected to resume operation later Tuesday after tripping off line earlier in the day, the operator said.
"It lost a condensate booster pump. It's supposed to be up at 4:00 (1600 EST/2100 GMT)," said a GPU Generation spokeswoman, referring to Conemaugh's unit 2.
The adjoining unit 1, with the same generating capacity, stayed on line when unit 2 fell off line, she said. "They saved unit 1."
The Conemaugh units in western Pennsylvania's Indiana County are jointly owned by utility members of the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect power pool.
GPU Generation is a subsidiary of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
